d:
The Santoor Maestro Pandit Shivkumar Sharma and the Bansuri legend Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia in Jugalbandi (Duet) at London's Barbican Centre accompanied by "Vikku" Vinayakram (Ghattam) and Ustad Shaft Ahmad Khan (Tabla).
Naina Shah and Uma Mehta provide Tanpura accompaniment. This brief excerpt from their rendition of the light classical melody in Raga Mishra Kafi is a Study in Simpatico of these two legends who were always in total harmony when playing together.
